network_status.network: ARPAE regional tele-hydrometric network and published event reports
network_status.summary_it: Il ponte è crollato il 24 maggio durante una nuova piena locale. Il rapporto idrometrico validato disponibile copre il 16-18 maggio: i colmi allora misurati sul Sillaro non vengono riutilizzati come misura dell’evento del 24 maggio.
network_status.summary_en: The bridge collapsed on 24 May during a new local flood. The available validated hydrometric report covers 16-18 May, so the peaks then measured on the Sillaro are not reused as a measurement of the 24 May event.

sources.title: Alluvione, continuano gli interventi di assistenza alla popolazione
Alluvione Bologna, crolla ponte a Monterenzio: residenti isolati a Villa Sassonero

curation_note.it: Il rapporto ARPAE 16-18 maggio contiene colmi validati sul Sillaro, ma il collasso di Villa Sassonero è documentato il 24 maggio durante un nuovo episodio locale. Per evitare una falsa associazione temporale, ARCUS non mostra quei colmi come misura del collasso e registra il gap come esito della revisione.
curation_note.en: The ARPAE 16-18 May report contains validated peaks on the Sillaro, but the Villa Sassonero collapse is documented on 24 May during a new local episode. To avoid a false temporal association, ARCUS does not display those peaks as a measurement of the collapse and records the gap as the review outcome.

provenance.method: Manual extraction: temporal-compatibility review of the official ARPAE report and event sources

caveats: Validated Sillaro peaks from 16-17 May are antecedent context and are not assigned to the 24 May collapse.
No compatible validated stage, discharge or hydrograph for the new local flood on 24 May is present in the curated sources.
The absence of a compatible published measurement does not imply absence or low magnitude of the local flood.
The documented scour label remains tied to the controlled event evidence and is not quantified by a hydrometric series.
